Research / Eco-Tourism / Nokrek region, Meghalaya

Citrus Gene Pool & Nokrek Base Camp

A landscape-led research and visitor programme connects citrus cultivation, interpretation and innovation with a base camp for exploring the Nokrek region. The study combines a fruit history centre, research facilities and visitor spaces.
